svg.title: Tick path on tick 5
svg.desc: Two copies of the tree move_cell on tick 5, one above the other and separated by a dashed line. Each has the orange root move_cell on the left, the children check_tester_ok, retry_pick and place_in_slot in the middle column, and pick_from_tester to the right of retry_pick. A status is written beside each node and under the root. Top, labeled memory=True: tag 1 on move_cell, which shows SUCCESS, and tag 2 on place_in_slot, which shows SUCCESS. check_tester_ok, retry_pick and pick_from_tester have a white fill and a dashed outline, and so do the lines to them; check_tester_ok shows SUCCESS (from tick 1) and pick_from_tester shows SUCCESS (from tick 4). Bottom, labeled memory=False: tags 1 to 4 on move_cell (RUNNING), check_tester_ok (SUCCESS), retry_pick and pick_from_tester (RUNNING (again)). place_in_slot has a white fill and a dashed outline and shows INVALID (stopped).
